title: VTC Events — Check-in — Record — payload
description: Check in to an event: a registrant signing over the door challenge, or self check-in where the calendar allows it, or door staff checking a registrant in by name. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

challenge.description: A registrant's check-in at the door: the challenge the door shows (VTI-EVT-162).

registrationId.description: Door staff checking a registrant in by name (VTI-EVT-163).

presentation.description: A partner community's member: the presentation that admits them (VTI-EVT-132).

occurrence.description: On a series registered by occurrence: the occurrence, by its original start (VTI-EVT-194). Refused on an event that is not one.

Response.title: VTC Events — Check-in — Record — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/checkin/record/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/checkin/record/0.2#response.

badgeOffered.description: Where the event names an attendance badge and the registrant is a member: the offer made to them, for them to accept (VTI-EVT-186).
